description: This Java source file defines a custom configuration class for Feign clients within a Spring Cloud OpenFeign setup. It extends default Feign client properties and specifies a custom error decoder bean.

classes.name: CustomFeignClientConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that customizes Feign client behavior by providing a custom error decoder.

methods.name: errorDecoder
methods.description: Defines a bean that provides a custom implementation of ErrorDecoder used by Feign clients.
